# acecloud_volume_backup (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud volume backup.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the backup. Must be alphanumeric with hyphens.
- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume to back up.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the backup.
- `incremental` (Boolean) Whether this is an incremental backup. Defaults to false.
- `snapshot_id` (String) ID of a snapshot to create the backup from (optional).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the backup was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the volume backup.
- `size` (Number) Size of the backup in GB.
- `status` (String) Current status of the backup (e.g. available, creating).
